title: Perbedaan Since dan For
subtitle: Memilih since untuk titik waktu dan for untuk durasi
objectives: Membedakan since untuk titik waktu dan for untuk durasi
Menghindari kesalahan umum dalam penggunaan since/for
Memilih kata yang tepat dalam konteks persahabatan

stages.name: Pembuka
stages.teacher_script: Selamat pagi! Kemarin kita belajar kosakata persahabatan. Siapa bisa sebutkan 3 kata baru yang dipelajari? Bagus. Hari ini kita akan fokus membedakan 'since' dan 'for' lebih dalam. Kita sudah belajar keduanya di pelajaran present perfect untuk durasi. Sekarang kita perdalam pemahaman supaya tidak tertukar. Coba pikirkan: kalau mau bilang 'sejak 2018', pakai 'since' atau 'for'? Kalau 'selama tiga tahun'? Itulah yang akan kita perdalam hari ini. Rencana: kita pelajari perbedaan detailnya, lalu berlatih memakainya dengan benar.
stages.instructions: Sapa murid dan tanyakan 3 kata kosakata kemarin. Ajak murid membedakan 'since' dan 'for'. Jelaskan tujuan: memperdalam perbedaan since dan for.

stages.name: Teori
stages.content:
## Perbedaan 'Since' dan 'For'

Kita sudah belajar keduanya di present perfect untuk durasi. Sekarang kita perdalam pemahaman supaya tidak tertukar.

## Aturan Utama

- **For** + **durasi** (jangka waktu: berapa lama)
  - for five years, for ten minutes, for a long time, for ages
- **Since** + **titik mulai** (waktu spesifik: kapan mulai)
  - since 2019, since January, since Monday, since I was a child

## Tabel Lengkap

| For (durasi) | Since (titik mulai) |
|---|---|
| for two hours | since 3 o'clock |
| for five years | since 2019 |
| for ten months | since January |
| for a long time | since I was young |
| for many weeks | since last week |
| for ages | since primary school |
| for a few days | since Monday |

## Cara Mengingat

- **For** menjawab: **How long?** (Berapa lama?)
  - I have known her **for** five years. (Berapa lama? Lima tahun.)
- **Since** menjawab: **Since when?** (Sejak kapan?)
  - I have known her **since** 2019. (Sejak kapan? 2019.)

## Contoh dalam Persahabatan

- We have been friends **for** ten years. (Berapa lama? Sepuluh tahun.)
- We have been friends **since** primary school. (Sejak kapan? Sekolah dasar.)
- I have trusted her **for** a long time.
- I have trusted her **since** we first met.
- Our friendship has lasted **for** many years.
- Our friendship has lasted **since** 2015.

## Kesalahan Umum

- Salah: 'I have known her since five years.' (since + durasi)
- Benar: 'I have known her for five years.' (for + durasi)
- Salah: 'I have known her for 2019.' (for + titik)
- Benar: 'I have known her since 2019.' (since + titik)

> **Hindari:** mencampur 'since' dengan durasi dan 'for' dengan titik waktu. Selalu cek: apakah kata setelahnya durasi (for) atau titik (since)?

> **Catatan:** Beberapa frasa bisa ambigu: 'for a long time' (durasi) vs 'since a long time ago' (titik). Lebih aman pakai 'for a long time'.

## Mini-dialogue

A: How long have you been friends?
B: We have been friends for ten years.
A: Since when exactly?
B: Since we started primary school in 2014.
key_points: 'For' + durasi (jangka waktu): for five years, for ten minutes.
'Since' + titik mulai (waktu spesifik): since 2019, since January.
Cek kata setelahnya: durasi -> for, titik -> since.
Keduanya dipakai dengan present perfect untuk menyatakan durasi.

stages.name: Latihan
stages.instructions:
1) **Drill (5 menit):** Guru menyebut frasa waktu, murid tentukan 'for' atau 'since'.
2) **Fill-in-the-blank (5 menit):** Lengkapi 10 kalimat dengan 'for' atau 'since'.
3) **Pair work (4 menit):** Tanyakan-jawab 'How long...?' dan 'Since when...?' tentang pertemanan.
4) **Role play (4 menit):** Dua murid memeragakan teman yang menceritakan lamanya pertemanan.
5) **Error correction (2 menit):** Perbaiki 3 kalimat salah (mis. 'since five years' -> 'for five years').

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: How long have you been friends?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: We have been friends for ten years.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Since we started primary school in 2014.
dialogue.id: Sejak kami mulai sekolah dasar tahun 2014.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: I have known her for a long time.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Now use 'since' with a point in time.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Correct this: 'I have known her since five years.'
dialogue.id: Perbaiki ini: 'I have known her since five years.'

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: It should be 'I have known her for five years.'
dialogue.id: Seharusnya 'I have known her for five years.'

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Because 'five years' is a duration, so we use 'for'.
dialogue.id: Karena 'five years' itu durasi, jadi pakai 'for'.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Good. Correct this: 'I have known her for 2019.'
dialogue.id: Bagus. Perbaiki ini: 'I have known her for 2019.'

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: It should be 'I have known her since 2019.'

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Perfect. Last: ask me 'How long' and 'Since when' about a friendship.
dialogue.id: Sempurna. Terakhir: tanyakan saya 'How long' dan 'Since when' tentang persahabatan.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: How long have you been friends? Since when?
dialogue.id: Sudah berapa lama Anda berteman? Sejak kapan?

stages.name: Penutup
stages.teacher_script: Hebat! Hari ini kalian sudah memperdalam perbedaan 'since' dan 'for'. Mari kita ingat: 'for' untuk durasi, 'since' untuk titik mulai. Coba saya tanya: 'for three years' atau 'since three years'? Benar, 'for three years'. Untuk PR, tulis 10 kalimat memakai 'for' dan 'since' dengan benar (campuran). Pertemuan berikutnya kita akan menyusun paragraf tentang teman memakai semua yang sudah dipelajari. Sampai jumpa!
stages.instructions: Tegaskan aturan 'for' = durasi, 'since' = titik. Berikan 1-2 pertanyaan pemahaman. Beri PR 10 kalimat dan umumkan topik menyusun paragraf.
